name: Meatball Gnocchi Bake
steps: Soak the fresh breadcrumbs in the cream and set aside.
Peel and finely chop the onion and garlic. Fry in a pan on a medium-low heat with a drizzle of olive oil.
While it is frying, slice up the stalks of the parsley and add to the pan, mixing everything together until the ingredients have softened. Take off the heat.
In a separate bowl place your minced beef. De-case the sausages, pushing the meat out of the sausage into the bowl and discarding the skins.
Add the fried onion, garlic and parsley into the mix. Add your soaked white breadcrumbs to the bowl. Begin to mix everything together.
Once mixed, create small meatballs, placing on a chopping board or tray. Cover and leave to rest in the fridge for 20 minutes.

After 20 mins, remove the meatballs from the fridge and begin to cook the meatballs in a large deep frying pan on a medium heat with a drizzle of olive oil. Gently turn the meatballs, letting them gain shape as they cook.
Once they have browned off, add 2 tins of tomatoes to allow the meatballs to cook through.
Add the gnocchi to the meatball pan and mix everything together, making sure everything is covered in tomato sauce. Let simmer for 5 mins.
Top with mozzarella and pop your pan under the grill until bubbling - this will take a couple of mins. Serve and enjoy.

pt.name: Nhoque com Almôndegas no Forno
steps: Mergulhe o pão ralado fresco nas natas e reserve.
Descasque e pique finamente a cebola e o alho. Frite numa frigideira em lume médio-baixo com um fio de azeite.
Enquanto frita, corte os talos de salsa e adicione à frigideira, misturando tudo até os ingredientes amolecerem. Retire do lume.
Numa tigela separada, coloque a carne picada. Retire as salsichas das tripas, empurrando a carne para a tigela e descartando as peles.
Adicione a cebola, o alho e a salsa fritos à mistura. Adicione o pão ralado demolhado. Comece a misturar tudo.
Assim que estiver misturado, forme pequenas almôndegas, colocando numa tábua de cortar ou tabuleiro. Tape e deixe repousar no frigorífico durante 20 minutos.

Após 20 minutos, retire as almôndegas do frigorífico e comece a cozinhá-las numa frigideira grande e funda em lume médio com um fio de azeite. Vire as almôndegas suavemente, deixando-as ganhar forma enquanto cozinham.
Assim que estiverem douradas, adicione 2 latas de tomate para que as almôndegas cozinhem completamente.
Adicione o nhoque à frigideira das almôndegas e misture tudo, garantindo que tudo fica coberto no molho de tomate. Deixe fervilhar 5 minutos.
Cubra com mozzarella e coloque a frigideira sob o grelhador até borbulhar — demora alguns minutos. Sirva e aproveite.
